verdict.rationale: Evidence documents Gemini's ability to generate and iteratively edit images (Nano Banana) with export/download at set resolutions, and general writing assistance, but there is no evidence of a dedicated document or presentation creation/editing workflow (e.g., a canvas-style doc/slide editor) with export to file formats. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating/iterating on text documents or slide decks, and exporting them to standard file formats (docx/pptx/pdf).
